name: How much does it cost to build an in-law suite in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build an in-law suite in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to build an in-law suite in the Los Angeles area varies significantly based on factors like size, chosen materials, and site conditions. A basic attached suite might start from $100,000, while a larger, custom-built detached ADU with high-end finishes could exceed $300,000. These figures include design, permits, and construction. Opus Builders provides detailed estimates after a site evaluation and understanding your specific design preferences. It's important to budget for both construction and potential utility connection upgrades.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for an in-law suite in Los Angeles vary widely, typically ranging from $100,000 for basic attached units to over $300,000 for custom detached builds, depending on size and finishes.
